name: @slurp/runtime
description: Optional browser runtime for Slurp themes: client navigation, {fetch} data loading and infinite scroll.
author: ByteSell LLC
//exports: The `./experimental/*` subpaths are implemented and unit-tested, but the compiler emits none of the markers they bind to (`x-data="slurpFetch(...)"`, `[data-slurp-sentinel]`), so against the 0.1.0 compiler they attach to nothing and silently do no work. They are named `experimental/` so that cannot be discovered at runtime. See README.md in this directory. Do not promote them to `./fetch` and `./infinite` until the codegen lands.
